name: Enterpret
summary: Customer-feedback intelligence platform (Enterpret) that classifies feedback with "an adaptive taxonomy trained for each customer" per its llms.txt. A first-party MCP server (wisdom-api.enterpret.com/server/mcp) gives a connected AI themes, counts and verbatims under the user's own login; a keyless initialize returned 401 Bearer, scope mcp:read mcp:write, on 2026-11-19. The vendor says the connected assistant writes the answer, so the claim on cs.summarize-customer-feedback covers the inputs only. Unmeasured.

payments.notes: Prices not public: llms.txt says pricing is custom, by feedback volume and integrations; /pricing is 404 (2026-11-19). Terms of Service s.5: unless the Order says otherwise, fees billed annually in advance, due within 30 days of invoice. No payment method named. Not machine-payable.

agentAccess.notes: Not keyless; needs an Enterpret account. Endpoint wisdom-api.enterpret.com/server/mcp; keyless POST initialize returned HTTP 401 Bearer, scope mcp:read mcp:write, 2026-11-19. OAuth (AS oauth.enterpret.com, user sign-in, no client credentials grant) or a user-tied dashboard token as bearer.

jobs.summary: Vendor-computed inputs: an adaptive taxonomy classifies feedback into themes; run_graph_query counts by taxonomy node; find_user_quote returns verbatims. The vendor says the connected assistant writes the answer, so the prose is the model's. Vendor docs, not measured.
